prompt: Apply show not tell to a book promo caption heavy with labels like 'hardest thing', 'worked incredibly hard', 'bad decisions', 'lonely success'

assertions.name: Removes generic telling labels
assertions.description: Output should not contain 'incredibly hard', 'hard work', 'sacrifices', 'bad decisions' as standalone labels

assertions.name: Contains at least one specific concrete scene or image
assertions.description: Output should contain a specific moment, place, action, or sensory detail — not just abstractions

assertions.name: Does not invent specific facts not in the original
assertions.description: If specific dollar amounts, dates, names, or events appear in the output that weren't in the input, they should be flagged or sourced

assertions.name: Ends with 'How does this land?' (with-skill only)
assertions.description: Skill instructs output to end with this phrase — baseline may not include it
